contextSentences.en: A chemical analysis of a soil sample can reveal past contamination or land use.
Statistical analysis methods allow patterns to be identified in large datasets.

words.example_en: The analysis is important in this field.
words.example_sk: Analýza je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

words.definition: The smallest unit of a living organism.

contextSentences.en: Stem cell research investigates how undifferentiated cells develop into specialised tissue cells.
Cancer research focuses on identifying which mutations turn a normal cell into a cancerous one.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how cell works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje bunka.

words.definition: Relating to chemistry or a substance used in chemistry.

contextSentences.en: A chemically pure sample contains only the desired substance with no impurities.
Chemically speaking, water is a polar compound with an unusually high boiling point.

words.definition: A judgment reached after considering evidence.

contextSentences.en: A conclusion must follow logically from the available data to be scientifically valid.
The researchers presented their conclusion at the conference and discussed it with colleagues.

words.definition: Facts and figures collected for study or analysis.

contextSentences.en: Big data technologies enable the processing and analysis of vast amounts of data in real time.
Scientific data must be reproducible and transparent so that other researchers can verify it.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term data.

words.definition: A basic substance that cannot be broken down chemically.

contextSentences.en: Transuranic elements are artificially created and heavier than uranium.
Spectral analysis makes it possible to identify an element by the light it emits.

words.definition: The capacity to do work or produce change.

contextSentences.en: Nuclear energy harnesses the energy released when heavy atomic nuclei are split.
How to store energy more efficiently is one of the most important questions in current research.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term energy.

words.definition: Information showing whether something is true.

contextSentences.en: Fossils provide direct evidence for the existence of species that went extinct long ago.
A mathematical proof is considered absolutely certain as long as the axioms and logic are correct.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how evidence works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje dôkaz.

words.definition: A scientific test carried out to discover something.

contextSentences.en: The double-slit experiment is considered one of the most elegant experiments in physics.
Placebo-controlled experiments are the gold standard in clinical research.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how experiment works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje experiment.

words.definition: A proposed explanation based on limited evidence.

contextSentences.en: A good hypothesis is falsifiable – it must be possible to disprove it through experiments.
After the original hypothesis failed, the researchers formulated a new, refined version.

words.example_en: The hypothesis is important in this field.
words.example_sk: Hypotéza je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

words.definition: A room equipped for scientific research or testing.

contextSentences.en: Biosafety level 4 laboratories study the most dangerous known pathogens.
Many of the most important scientific discoveries were initially made by accident in a laboratory.

words.definition: The smallest unit of a chemical compound.

contextSentences.en: The structure of the insulin molecule was the first protein to be fully resolved by X-ray crystallography.
Mass spectrometry can determine the precise mass of a molecule.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how molecule works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje molekula.

words.definition: To watch carefully in order to learn something.

contextSentences.en: Astronomers observe distant galaxies using radio telescopes that detect radio waves.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term observe.

words.definition: Careful study intended to discover new facts.

contextSentences.en: Basic research aims to advance understanding rather than to produce immediate practical results.
Interdisciplinary research combines methods and knowledge from several different fields.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term research.

words.definition: A set of ideas intended to explain something.

contextSentences.en: The theory of evolution is one of the best-supported theories in the history of biology.
In science, a theory is not a guess but a well-evidenced explanatory framework.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term theory.
